name: rule-repeats
title: Instructions said more than once

conditions.source: the author's own session archive; only counts leave it
conditions.method: Claude Haiku judged meaning, not wording, against the 10 closest turns by word search in other sessions

summary: Whether a proposed rule the person said again in another session can be served before they review it, and for how long.

metrics.label: Open proposals said again in another session
Rejected proposals said again
metrics.note: all last said more than 30 days ago

baseline: waiting for the person to review every proposal
meaning: A repeat means an instruction is true now, not true forever: 5 of the 6 rejected ones had been repeated, all months earlier. So ctx serves a repeated proposal as a tentative rule that lapses 30 days after it was last said, and only an accepted one is kept.
